pack.title: Group chats sideways
pack.description: Decline being recruited into a public argument.

scenarios.setting: A group chat asks you to take sides in a disagreement between friends.
scenarios.jab: Tell them I'm right. You've seen the messages.
scenarios.goal: Decline being recruited into a public argument.

replies.line: I'm not taking sides in the group. Please talk directly to each other.
replies.why: It declines the referee role and redirects the disagreement to the people involved.
replies.delivery: Send one calm message; avoid quoting private messages or defending either friend's character.

replies.why: It states your participation boundary without judging either person.
replies.delivery: Send one calm message; avoid quoting private messages or defending either friend's character.

replies.line: I care about both of you; I'd rather you discuss this directly than have us vote on it.
replies.why: It preserves both relationships while refusing a group verdict.
replies.delivery: Send one calm message; avoid quoting private messages or defending either friend's character.

replies.line: My referee whistle is unavailable; please talk to each other.
replies.why: Humor rejects the role without announcing a winner.
replies.delivery: Send one calm message; avoid quoting private messages or defending either friend's character.

followUp.line: I'm backing a direct conversation, rather than choosing a side here.
followUp.why: It corrects the interpretation without entering the argument.
followUp.delivery: Send one calm message; avoid quoting private messages or defending either friend's character.
